text: The Board of Directors of CreateTO considered the item at its meeting on July 7, 2021. The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Established a Human Resources Committee and: a. appointed the following members to the Committee: Sandra Levy (Chair), Dennis Fotinos, Councillor Paula Fletcher and Marcie Zajdeman; b. requested the Committee to consider the report (June 24, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, and any other related human resources matters; c. requested the Committee to report back to the Board in September on the report (June24, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, and a proposed terms of reference for the Committee; d. requested the City Clerk to provide meeting management support to the Committee.

The CreateTO - Human Resources Committee: 1. Directed that confidential attachment 1 to the report (June 24, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO remain confidential as it deals with personal matters about an identifiable person or persons.
